A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

constitutive GSK-3 activity protects against pathological hypertrophic remodelling of adult hearts in response to chronic β-adrenerigic stimulation, and that the mechanism by which it does so is through the maintenance of physiological hypertrophy and contractile reserve.

GSK-3 is a critical mediator of the cardiac response to chronic adrenergically induced stress.
